author: kcreepertux04
content: Well I mean it really does matter for a company like mine, we have thin margins. We only make ¢3 for every $1 spent in the stores. So theft absolutely eats into that a lot, and it’s part of the reason we’ve have to close so many stores is because the theft makes them unprofitable so why would we stay open? It creates pharmacy deserts.

It also makes the work of all of the rest of us so much worse cuz we have to start putting extra labor into locking things up and having to come unlock things for you, nobody wants to be doing it but if people didn’t steal then it wouldn’t be an issue
